faster_scientific_understanding.evidence: No practitioner study is recorded; the task decomposition was published as diagnostic-only. The 50% hands-on target has no baseline and cannot be judged in this phase.

investigations_previously_too_expensive.evidence: Measured in-process amortization on the 1000-case W-CAMPAIGN grid is 1.329x (median 0.557s vs 0.741s per case), far short of the drafted 10x. The comparator leg is unmeasurable on this workstation: ALARA's only library covers zero contract elements (contract_gap on all 1016 cases); FISPACT-II, SCALE/ORIGEN and OpenMC are unavailable. A deeper amortization route (shared prepared-network load) was outside P26's prototype budget.

reliable_assisted_work.evidence: Depends on P27 contract families that do not exist yet; no evidence either way was produced.

reproduction_and_interoperability.evidence: Hash-pinned provenance and the certificate/ledger path are demonstrated (feasible component); the spatial handoff leg has no executable comparator and no transport validation was run.

useful_predictive_results.evidence: P24-CONDITIONAL demonstrates independent controls and explicit coverage accounting on a qualified domain; P25-FAIL bounds the breadth. Predictive superiority remains unmeasured by design (no predeclared measurement comparison was run).

release_hold: unchanged — the 1.1.0 decision remains the maintainer's
verdict_rule: P26-FAIL: three draft targets undetermined and the headroom ambition not supported by measured evidence (1.33x amortization; comparator leg unmeasurable). Amendment 1 used the single repair round.
